title: New footing connects different impressions
meaning: Your shared view can gain harmony when changing conditions receive an understandable and dependable explanation.
text: Different impressions can become compatible when the change is clear. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Ajna suggests updating explanations alongside conditions. The Emperor in energy supports wanting dependable grounds for understanding. Temperance in emotions feels different aspects fit together. You may enjoy earlier and present experience no longer excluding one another. Your shared view gains a structure showing each observation’s place and preserving a clear connection between changed conditions and familiar material’s new appearance.

For example, you examine photographs of one shelf before and after a lamp was moved. The books previously seemed an even row; now particular spines stand out more. **Understandable footing can connect impressions from different conditions.** You update the explanation and see side lighting’s significance. The new picture accommodates both observations. It feels pleasing that neither impression has to be declared wrong: each relates to its own lighting. Your view gains stability through the relationship between conditions while harmony preserves differences between what stood out earlier and now.

The risk is requiring every discrepancy to be explained by changing conditions because compatibility feels pleasing. A real difference between observations may then escape examination. Wanting dependable grounds preserves accuracy: this particular connection is understood while another case may need its own explanation without fitting the earlier arrangement.
